final: SELECT grouped.order_reference AS original_order_reference, grouped.time_in_force, grouped.group_average_units_filled, grouped.group_average_units_filled - averages.time_in_force_average AS difference, grouped.rank FROM (SELECT order_reference, time_in_force, group_average_units_filled, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY time_in_force ORDER BY group_average_units_filled DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM (SELECT order_reference, time_in_force, AVG(units_filled) AS group_average_units_filled FROM (SELECT e.fillcount AS units_filled, o.recordvault AS order_reference, o.timespan AS time_in_force FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY) AS matched GROUP BY order_reference, time_in_force)) AS grouped JOIN (SELECT time_in_force, AVG(group_average_units_filled) AS time_in_force_average FROM (SELECT order_reference, time_in_force, AVG(units_filled) AS group_average_units_filled FROM (SELECT e.fillcount AS units_filled, o.recordvault AS order_reference, o.timespan AS time_in_force FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY) AS matched GROUP BY order_reference, time_in_force) GROUP BY time_in_force) AS averages ON grouped.time_in_force = averages.time_in_force COLLATE BINARY WHERE grouped.group_average_units_filled > averages.time_in_force_average AND grouped.rank <= 3
